native_global_control: integer frame QP with inherited P shifts; no continuous external rate knob
fixed_cost_constraint: v1 cost+80 is physically correct, not removed
delta_formula: native_target_bits + 80 + sum(single_delta_vs_empty_envelope); each single delta already contains its own 88 decision bits
tolerance: [0.995*target,target], all control bytes charged; no over-budget comparison
tolerance_basis: predeclared tight 0.5% maximum shortfall in actual bytes; no over-budget quality advantage is admitted, discrete RANS bytes and integer QPs prevent arbitrary exact tuning
transfer_to_neighbor_q: additive rate surrogate only; each actual candidate re-encoded and must pass actual budget
